policy: No blanket directory copy. Exactly36 released runtime public payloads and30 original STOP payloads plus explicitly selected static/source/config files. No original is rewritten.
excluded: Private runtime/**, baseline-private, fixture manifests, generated credentials and contacts
Auth/session/cookie/storage exports, native session connection metadata
Raw full viewport and failed/private images, raw absolute private diagnostic files
Original static logs/JSON with private paths; only named sanitized clones are published
Unavailable intermediate root source history and historical page source bytes
Executing any archived harness; tests, installs, services, browsers, fixtures, native, Next or PostgreSQL during publication
ownIndexExclusions: evidence-index.json indexes archive/** payloads only. publication-seal.json indexes every publication file except itself. Its external digest is in ignored HANDOFF-publication.json; no circular self-hash.
